name: Example: Finding the Solution of an Intermediate System Using the LU Factorization of a 3x3 Matrix
problem:
Consider the matrix $L$ and the vector $\mathbf b,$ given by 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14063081/assets/f88cbbb9459dd3b467e6b87d230ad23634461597aa9d8da3e933774273e2ab2f.png)
If $A=LU$ is the LU factorization of some $3\times 3$ matrix $A,$ find the vector $\mathbf{y}$ such that

$$
{\begin{aligned}Ly=b \\ Ux=y\end{aligned}
$$

is equivalent to $A\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{b}.$
worked_solution:
First, notice that since $A=LU,$ we can write

$$
\begin{aligned}Ax=b\,⟹\,{{(LU)}_{⏟}}_{A}x=b.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, setting $U\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{y},$ we obtain

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14063081/assets/7704f9285f14f496bb9f1721d188866c9464c585e33235c5cc6eee42e3f3a3eb.png)

We now solve $L\mathbf{y} = \mathbf{b}.$ Writing this equation in matrix form, we get

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14063081/assets/712643d674cf8a7a086a9a935659d86bba7bd2fb25f131ec56e798cfc1d538d9.png)

This gives the system of equations

$$
{\begin{aligned}{y}_{1}=2 \\ {y}_{1}+{y}_{2}=4 \\ {y}_{1}-2{y}_{2}+{y}_{3}=1.\end{aligned}
$$

We can compute the solution to this system using forward substitution, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} & =2, \\ {y}_{2} & =4-{y}_{1} \\  & =4-(2) \\  & =2, \\ {y}_{3} & =1-{y}_{1}+2{y}_{2} \\  & =1-(2)+2(2) \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,
